Summarize Raster Indicator by Spatial Grid or General Footprint (Deprecated)

Source: R/grids.R
d4h_summarize_grid.Rd

This function is deprecated in favor of d4h_executive_summary with grid = ... or by = "grid". Generates a square or hexagonal spatial grid and extracts zonal summary statistics of raster indicators per grid cell.

Usage

d4h_summarize_grid(
  raster_in,
  cell_size = 20,
  square = TRUE,
  discard_na = TRUE,
  general = FALSE,
  exact_boundary = TRUE
)

d4h_summarize_general(raster_in, exact_boundary = TRUE)

Arguments

raster_in

SpatRaster or character. Input raster layer, stack, or path to file.

cell_size

Numeric. Grid cell size / diameter in meters (default: 20). Ignored when general = TRUE.

square

Logical. If TRUE, creates square cells; if FALSE, hexagonal cells (default: TRUE). Ignored when general = TRUE.

discard_na

Logical. If TRUE, removes grid cells outside the valid raster data area (default: TRUE). Ignored when general = TRUE.

general

Logical. If TRUE, computes the overall mean value of raster layers across the entire area of interest as a single spatial vector polygon (SpatVector) with grid_id = "GENERAL" (default: FALSE).

exact_boundary

Logical. When general = TRUE, if TRUE, traces the exact outer boundary of valid non-NA flight data; if FALSE, uses the bounding box extent (default: TRUE).

Value

A SpatVector or sf containing the grid cells (or single general footprint polygon) with extracted values.
